title: Navis Apexialis
description:
A global content module for Imperium Maledictum: playable species, expanded talents, a xenos and heretic bestiary, the mechanics that drive them, and a skin for the whole interface.

The Species compendium adds a real Species item type: drop a race onto a character and it applies the whole package — characteristics, skills, traits, size and gear — with a Subspecies slot beside it. The roster is the DoomBC line converted to impmal's own scale.

Talents and the bestiary come from Maledictum Expanded by Meins, re-catalogued into a colour-coded folder taxonomy and repaired against the impmal system enums and the official impmal-core compendium. See docs/migration-report.md for every change made to the source data.

The skin repaints sheets, chat, every window, the sidebar and the hotbar in plate, brass and rust. Players can switch it off in their own settings.

Credits for Imperium Maledictum go to Moxy.

flags.role: Maledictum Expanded, the source of this release's content

recommends.reason: Every item in this module uses artwork shipped with impmal-core, and the Pariah subspecies grants the system's own Blank talent from its compendium. Without it, entries fall back to blank icons and the Pariah loses its mechanics.
Carries the Russian names and rules text for the compendium documents themselves, which a language file cannot reach. Without it the interface is still Russian and the compendiums stay English.
